persistedCommandCoverage.existing: Core has generic persisted command-path evidence. GearSwapCombatPreviewR131Tests.testBothUnassignedCandidatesAndActualEquipResolveMatch compares preview to actual .equip then .resolveChallenge, but the test uses in-memory SaveRepository(initial:), not file-backed cold reopen. EquipmentLoadoutsR342Tests uses file-backed SaveRepository, dispatches equip/save/apply/clear, reopens and checks exact snapshot/receipt; it does not resolve a challenge in that sequence. CurrentProfileProgressionE2ERunnerR120Tests dispatches actual .resolveChallenge and reopens file-backed SaveRepository after every virtual day, asserting snapshot equality.
persistedCommandCoverage.assessment: No general SaveRepository or equip/resolve defect identified. What is missing is a persisted paired comparison of these exact R368 UUIDs, where each copy dispatches actual .equip + .resolveChallenge, stores lastCombatResult/receipt, and cold-reopens. That is a narrow evidence gap if R376/R377 are to substantiate persistent alternative-build outcomes; it is not evidence of a broken persistence implementation.
persistedCommandCoverage.smallestOptionalReplay: Two isolated file-backed copies of the pinned R368 snapshot: one C_WITCH weapon = BC499... control, the other = 6CA... or 68C... candidate. Dispatch equip and one matching challenge per pair with the same seed, assert receipt/revision, expected loadout UUID and lastCombatResult across reopen. Keep acquisition route UNKNOWN for 6CA/68C unless a UUID-to-draw record exists. No reward or balance claim.

conclusion: The pairs are owned in a free/no-ad simulated 30-day R368 cohort; direct EQ_W_01 and both EQ_S_01 records have daily-report natural UUID joins, while poison EQ_W_P1 and barrier EQ_W_G2 lack an exact per-instance origin join. Summon logs make gacha a plausible route for those templates, not proven provenance for the UUIDs. Existing results demonstrate descriptive preview behavior (poison events; barrier/absorb/reflect events), not causal effect magnitude, persisted paired resolution, or approved balance. No product-code defect established.
